name: Unleash With Postgresql
description: Open source feature flag management for enterprises.
composeYaml:
services:
  unleash:
    image: 'unleashorg/unleash-server:latest'
    environment:
      - 'UNLEASH_URL=${APP_URL}'
      - 'UNLEASH_DEFAULT_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${UNLEASH_PASSWORD}'
      - 'DATABASE_URL=postgres://${POSTGRES_USER}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@postgres/db'
      - DATABASE_SSL=false
      - LOG_LEVEL=warn
      - 'INIT_FRONTEND_API_TOKENS=default:default:development.unleash-insecure-frontend-api-token'
      - 'INIT_CLIENT_API_TOKENS=default:development.unleash-insecure-api-token'
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: 'wget --no-verbose --tries=1 --spider http://127.0.0.1:4242/health || exit 1'
      interval: 1s
      timeout: 1m
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s
  postgres:
    image: 'postgres:15'
    volumes:
      - 'postgresql-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data'
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=${POSTGRES_USER}
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_DB=db
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - pg_isready
        - '--username=${POSTGRES_USER}'
        - '--host=127.0.0.1'
        - '--port=5432'
        - '--dbname=db'
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 1m
      retries: 5
      start_period: 10s
